approved_scope: Approved as a mission-scoped VALIDATED risk/dependency item: the OLE v1 foundation does not yet automatically initiate candidate-learning processing on mission closure and currently depends on a human-issued trigger, evidenced first-hand by this mission's own manually-initiated learning handoff. This promotion does not authorize Stage 4B implementation and does not alter GitHub issue #590's deferred status; it records the risk as approved organizational learning, not as a license to build the missing automation.

evidence.locator: Section 1, 'Purpose': 'Until the deferred Stage 4B background automation is implemented and formally accepted, Smart Business must not rely on memory or informal habit to initiate Organizational Learning Engine processing... it does not yet automatically notice every authoritative mission closure and initiate the full candidate-learning flow in the background.'

Section 2, 'Standing rule': 'A future Smart Business mission must not be considered fully closed by Mission Control until one of the following is durably recorded...'; line 112: 'GitHub issue #590 tracks the deferred Stage 4B capability whose purpose is to remove this manual initiation dependency.'

Document records that OLE learning handoff for this mission's own completed implementation was recorded as 'INITIATED' by Mission Control specifically because the standing rule required a durable, explicit trigger -- not because the engine detected the closure on its own.
